entities.name: Hans W. Liepmann
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Hans Wolfgang Liepmann was an American fluid dynamicist,
aerospace scientist and emeritus Theodore von Kármán Professor of Aeronautics at the California Institute of Technology.
